question: Should Matrix expose receipt timing as a supported operator policy, and should `on-reply` acknowledge only a successfully delivered visible final message?
rationale: The request adds a persistent public configuration contract and deliberately changes the meaning of Matrix acknowledgement for selected accounts; code review alone cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Approve bounded receipt modes
options.body: Add plugin-owned `immediate`, `on-reply`, and `off` modes with immediate as the inherited default and explicit final-delivery tests.

options.title: Keep immediate-only behavior
options.body: Retain the shipped receipt-on-arrival contract and direct operators to use the current Matrix behavior without a timing override.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded receipt modes
recommendation.body: Add plugin-owned `immediate`, `on-reply`, and `off` modes with immediate as the inherited default and explicit final-delivery tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identified contributor to the shipped immediate-receipt behavior that this request would extend.
